LZ4 1.10.0

Source: https://github.com/lz4/lz4/tree/v1.10.0/lib

`lz4.c`, `lz4.h`, `lz4hc.c`, `lz4hc.h` and `LICENSE` (BSD 2-Clause) were
copied unchanged from that release. This is the same LZ4 version that
drakmor's ampr_emu pins for its runtime block decoder, so packs written on the
PS5 decode with the exact implementation the game-side runtime uses.
